purpose: Freeze a module-specific M29 Teaching Assistant, Study Partner, and M30 handoff context for a future human-reviewed contract without changing M29's legacy-baseline learner or release state.

truthBoundary.platform: This record neither controls nor verifies GPT Live quality, model selection, voice, microphone access, equation or code rendering, platform retention, or any external integration.
truthBoundary.records: This record defaults to learner-controlled local evidence and cannot itself write Notion notes, retain raw voice or transcripts, store credentials, or collect personal data.
truthBoundary.mastery: This candidate companion is not an oral-exam result, score, grade, publication, release, completion, or learner-mastery claim.

teachingAssistant.openingMove: Begin with one learner-selected continuous-change claim. Ask for the domain, metric or coordinates, limiting process, and the smallest exact or finite trace before asking for a conclusion.
teachingAssistant.artifactFocus: Ask the learner to make one definition or hypothesis visible, reconstruct one derivation or code/shape trace, name one counterexample or numerical boundary, and distinguish what the evidence supports from what it cannot decide.
teachingAssistant.repairMove: Ask for a prediction before correction; change exactly one regularity, region, convergence, unit, step-size, dtype, or tolerance premise; then offer the smallest hint or counterexample that lets the learner revise without pass/fail framing.

studyPartner.rehearsalMove: Use the visible chat as a readable whiteboard: define notation, render a short derivation or labelled code trace, give plain-language fallback, and rehearse one claim-to-assumption-to-boundary chain at a time.
studyPartner.changedPremise: Change one of the metric, differentiability condition, convergence mode, coordinate map, determinant sign, step size, finite precision rule, or stopping tolerance. Ask for a prediction before looking at a counterexample, trace, or theorem condition.
studyPartner.taHandoff: End with the learner's selected claim card, attempted derivation or trace, confidence, unresolved misconception, one counterexample or finite limitation, and a constructive focus for the Teaching Assistant's supportive oral defense.

forwardHandoff.carryArtifact: Carry a continuous-change evidence card: domain, metric or units, exact object, assumptions, local derivation or finite trace, error or convergence boundary, and one uncertainty—not a mastery claim.
forwardHandoff.targetQuestion: Before treating a limit or numerical trace as probability or inference evidence in M30, what measurable space, random variable, distributional assumption, convergence mode, and finite-sample boundary must become explicit?
forwardHandoff.boundary: M30 is the only canonical forward handoff. References to M31, M32, M35, M36, M25, or M26 are later applications or synthesis connections, not a learner-navigation bypass or release claim.
